name: project-loop
description: Closed-loop, evidence-gated build system for AI coding agents. Plan, Spec, Build, Verify — with a separate Judge role that holds the exit gate and issues rework orders until the frozen Definition of Done is met.

scripts.test: npm run test:cli && npm run test:lifecycle
scripts.lint: node --check bin/project-loop.js && node --check cli/index.js && node --check cli/install.js && node --check cli/prompts.js && node --check cli/targets.js && node --check cli/config.js
scripts.clean: find . \( -name node_modules -o -name .git \) -prune -o -name '__pycache__' -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 rm -rf; find . -name '*.pyc' -delete 2>/dev/null; true
